name: duet
description: How Claude Duet works, written for the Claude agents running inside it: where plugins come from and when they load, how channels, threads and sessions relate, and how a channel's repos are attached, when to give complex multi-task work its own channel, and how to keep Linear tickets up to date as work moves. Install it to your claude.ai chat plugins so every new Duet thread and channel starts out knowing. Grows one skill at a time as new Duet behavior is learned.
